verified_source.document: FIA 2026 F1 Regulations, Section B Sporting, Issue 07, 25 June 2026

articles.B8.2.2: per driver per Championship: 3 ICE, 3 TC, 3 EXH, 2 ES, 2 PU-CE, 2 MGU-K, 5 PU-ANC
articles.B8.2.3: one additional unit of each element in the 2026 Championship
articles.B8.2.7: a replacement driver is deemed the original driver for PU usage (allocation is per driver)
articles.B8.2.8: each additional element: 10 grid places the first time an additional element of that type is used, 5 places the next times; cumulative
articles.B8.2.8_same_event: if several of the same element are introduced at one Competition, only the last fitted may be used later without penalty
articles.B2.5.4b: <=15 cumulative places: temporary slot = qualifying position + penalty (ties: slowest keeps it, others ahead), unpenalised fill free slots in qualifying order, penalised move up to fill gaps; >15: behind all other classified drivers, in qualifying order

synthetic.label: SYNTHETIC season-length scaling and logistics; NOT an FIA rule
synthetic.element_mapping: the engine models three elements: ICE, turbo (FIA TC) and energy_store (FIA ES); EXH, PU-CE, MGU-K and PU-ANC are not modelled
synthetic.scaling_rule: allocation_8_races = 1 + ceil((real_allocation - 1) * 8 / 24), so the season-length ratio of spare elements is kept for an 8-race calendar
synthetic.team_physical_stock_note: new elements a team has available to fit over the season (shared by its two drivers); a REPLACE needs one in stock. Logistics placeholder, not an FIA rule
synthetic.pool_reuse: NOT modelled: a replaced element is retired (no rotation of used elements); the B8.2.8 same-event rule is therefore moot
synthetic.grid_size: 8 cars; FIA wording for 20+ cars applied to 8 slots

field_size_scaling.label: SYNTHETIC: FIA grid places are for a 22-car field; places are scaled by 8/22 and rounded so a penalty costs a similar share of the field

unchanged: wear, pace loss, reliability, the published rival replacement threshold and all race mechanics are the 1.1.0/2.0.1 models
